title: IDKMesh Control Tower Inspection Response v0.1
description: The success envelope returned by `POST /api/v1/run-evidence/inspect` (docs/specifications/CONTROL_TOWER_LOCAL_API_V0_1.md), wrapping one deterministic, digest-bound `idkmesh-control-tower-snapshot`. The wrapper itself carries no authority; `snapshot_digest` is the canonical digest of `snapshot`, so a caller can detect a swapped or corrupted snapshot without re-deriving it. The full snapshot shape is its own frozen contract -- schemas/control-tower-snapshot-v0.1.schema.json -- and is intentionally not duplicated here; this schema only constrains the wrapper and the snapshot's own identity fields.

snapshot_digest.description: canonical_digest() of the sibling snapshot field.
